rules.conflictOrdinance: Miami-Dade County Code Sec. 2-11.1 (Conflict of Interest and Code of Ethics Ordinance) applies to municipal officials in the County: https://library.municode.com/fl/miami_-_dade_county/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=PTIIICOOR_CH2AD_ARTIINGE_S2-11.1COINCOET ; F.S. ch. 112 part III (Code of Ethics for Public Officers and Employees).
rules.abstentionRule: F.S. 112.3143(3): a municipal officer may not vote on a measure inuring to the special private gain or loss of the officer, a principal, a relative or a business associate; must state the interest before the vote and file Form 8B within 15 days with the person recording the minutes. https://www.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0100-0199/0112/Sections/0112.3143.html
rules.ethicsBody: Miami-Dade Commission on Ethics and Public Trust (https://ethics.miamidade.gov/) and Florida Commission on Ethics (https://ethics.state.fl.us/).

notes: Municipal elected officials filed CE Form 1 for 2025 (enforcement of SB 774's move to Form 6 is enjoined for municipal officials in Loper v. Lukis, S.D. Fla. No. 1:24-cv-20604). Form 1 reports sources and categories, not dollar values. Forms read 2026-10-23 from Florida COE EFDMS through its public JSON endpoints (/api/PublicFiling/SearchPublicFilers and /api/PublicFiling/SearchFilingHistory) and the filing PDFs (/Report/GetFormContent?filingId=<id>, viewable at /Report/PrintForm/?filingId=<id>). Sunbiz: officer/registered-agent searches by name on search.sunbiz.org; rows marked 'name and filed address match' share a business address printed on the official's own form. Home addresses are not recorded.
